The following logical clauses must all be true, where a variable may be true or false and 'not X' means X is false. Exactly one assignment of the variables satisfies every clause.

  (not P or R)
  (not Q or not P)
  (not P)
  (not P or R)
  (not P)
  (not P or not Q)
  (not P or R)
  (not Q or R)
  (not P or not Q)
  (not P or not Q)
  (not Q)
  (R or not P)
  (not P or R)
  (R)

Give the value of P, Q, R in that order, each as true or false, separated by commas, on the last line in the form 'Answer: <value>, <value>, ...'.
